info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Notional Pooling Management API
info.description: The Notional Pooling Management API enables financial institutions to manage notional pooling arrangements efficiently. This API allows users to set up, modify, and monitor notional pooling configurations, optimizing liquidity across multiple accounts. Typical consumers include treasury departments, financial analysts, and systems integrating with banking operations. By automating these processes, organizations can improve cash visibility and reduce interest expenses on surplus liquidity.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a notional pooling trade within the trade banking system, enabling efficient cash management across multiple accounts. It streamlines the process of pooling funds and optimizing interest results for businesses.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a notional pooling operation in trade banking. This should include all necessary parameters for the operation in JSON format.
